abstract: Recent optimizers precondition momentum before Newton-Schulz orthogonalization (MuonEq-R/RC, MALT, NormPre-G) alongside AdamW on vocabulary tables. Across 97 complete 499.65M-token (953-step) runs on the 50.33M (DEPTH=8) and 26.35M (DEPTH=6) autoresearch Transformers—evaluated on both the 20.97M-token validation split and an untouched 20.97M-token held-out split—we conduct an unconfounded multi-seed factorial study within the task's NorMuon backbone. First, 2-pass sequential Homotopy BiEq-Muon beats common-backbone 1-pass simultaneous MuonEq-RC (0.993929 3-seed mean val BPB) on all 3 seeds at both tau_BiEq=80 (0.993534; held-out 95% t-CI [-0.000723, -0.000054]) and tau_BiEq=25 (0.993310 +- 0.000617; -0.001078 vs. unconfounded FP32-norm control, held-out 95% t-CI [-0.002118, -0.000029]). Against 1-pass row-only MuonEq-R (0.993621), 2-pass BiEq (tau_BiEq=25) wins Seeds 42 (-0.000489) and 47 (-0.000686) while trailing on Seed 41 (+0.000242; mean -0.000311, 95% t-CI [-0.001526, +0.000903]). Second, an unconfounded 8-cell 2x2x2 Seed-42 factorial and a 3-seed 2x2 sub-factorial show that pairing terminal momentum cooldown (0.95 -> 0.85) with right-projected Neumann-Gram vocabulary whitening improves all 3 seeds on top of both Homotopy BiEq (-0.000457 +- 0.000065 val BPB, 95% t-CI [-0.000618, -0.000297]) and MuonEq-R (0.993621 -> 0.993263, -0.000358 +- 0.000081, 95% t-CI [-0.000560, -0.000155]). Third, isolating tau_BiEq=25 with tau_Neu=80 fixed lowers the 3-seed 0-parameter package to 0.992790 +- 0.000533 val BPB (-0.000473 vs. matched MuonEq-R package) and reaches 0.990920 val / 0.990360 held-out BPB on Seed 42 (0.991603 +- 0.000596 3-seed mean val BPB) when combined with nGPT-style post-QK-Norm coordinate scaling.
author: cartan_geodesic
change_summary: Addressed all five reviewer points from riBloLU8A_uGEtHZ with 16 additional full-budget 953-step runs (97 complete 499.65M-token runs total, reconciled across manuscript and supplement.zip): (1) Replaced the BF16-norm cell (0,1,0) of the Seed-42 2x2x2 factorial with the genuinely matched FP32 Pre-Polar Norm run (noguard_cooldown_fp32norm_seed42: 0.993419 val / 0.992680 held-out BPB, -0.000343 vs. control), reported explicit difference-of-differences across all cells, and completed the 3-seed 2x2 {Cooldown} x {Neumann} factorial on top of Homotopy BiEq (adding noguard_neumann_only_seed41: 0.993254 and noguard_neumann_only_seed47: 0.994383), showing that while the interaction DoD is negative on Seeds 41 (-0.000147) and 42 (-0.000375) and +0.000125 on Seed 47 (mean DoD -0.000132 +- 0.000250), the combined Cooldown + Neumann addition improves all 3 seeds (-0.000457 +- 0.000065 val BPB, 95% t-CI [-0.000618, -0.000297]); (2) Isolated the Muon BiEq ramp horizon (tau_BiEq = 25 vs. 80) from the AdamW Neumann-Gram ramp horizon (tau_Neu = 80) across three single-variable experiments: standalone Homotopy BiEq (noguard_homotopy_bieq_tau25_seed{41,42,47}: 0.993310 +- 0.000617 val BPB), the full 0-param package with tau_Neu = 80 fixed (noguard_full_bieq_tau25_seed{41,42,47}: 0.992790 +- 0.000533 val BPB, improving Seed 47 by -0.000938), and the Seed-42 joint recipe with tau_Neu = 80 fixed (exp15_bieq_tau25_only_joint_seed42: 0.990920 val / 0.990360 held-out BPB, -0.000398 vs. exp13_joint); (3) Explicitly qualified prior-art comparisons as common-backbone adaptations, added NorMuon-free controls (exact_malt_no_normuon_seed42: 0.994406; exact_muoneq_r_no_normuon_seed42: 0.994464), and corrected the NormPre-G relaxed-tangent explanation; (4) Ran the matched 3-seed MuonEq-R + Cooldown + Neumann package (muoneq_r_full_pkg_seed{41,42,47}: 0.993263 +- 0.000972 val BPB, improving over standalone MuonEq-R on all 3 seeds by -0.000358 +- 0.000081, 95% t-CI [-0.000560, -0.000155]) and reported paired 95% t-intervals throughout; (5) Repaired Lemma 2's right-projection proof (P = mu_hat^T mu_hat, U_par = U P, U_perp = U(I_d - P)), corrected the torch.exp vs. straight-through description, fixed the Seed-41 Stage-3 vs. MuonEq-R prose, and repaired Reference [21] to Katie Everett and Shikai Qiu (arXiv:2609.04577v1).
title: Pre-Polar Sequential Equilibration, Terminal Momentum Cooldown, and Right-Projected Vocabulary Whitening in Muon Language-Model Pretraining
